title: Send now, round 3 — matching the app's send button

steps.path: The right end of a waiting message, above the message box
steps.headline: Send now now looks like the message box's own send button: the theme's accent colour and the same arrow.
steps.changed: Round 2's hand-styled black button with an up arrow is replaced by the app's standard send button style, the same one the message box uses, just slightly smaller to fit the row.
steps.notice: It matches the send button below it in every theme, and lines up with the pencil and trash icons.
steps.risk: It points right like the message box's send arrow, not up as you first described.

steps.path: Hovering Send now on a waiting message
steps.headline: On hover, "Interrupt and Send Now" rolls out inside the accent button; the trash slides left with it.
steps.changed: Same roll-out as round 2, now inside the matching button.
steps.notice: You see what it will do before you click.
steps.risk: Phones have no hover, so there it stays the arrow alone.

steps.path: The same button in the Midnight theme — at rest (top) and hovered (bottom)
steps.headline: In Midnight it takes that theme's accent, like the message box's send button does.
steps.changed: Your pick from round 2: the theme's accent colour in every theme.
steps.notice: Top picture at rest, bottom picture hovered.
